Some opening scenes stay with us forever, even when we've forgotten much of what happens in the rest of the film. The Joker revealing himself during The Dark Knight's bank robbery. Hans Landa calmly interrogating a terrified farmer in Inglourious Basterds. A young woman disappearing beneath the water in Jaws.

From Steven Spielberg to David Fincher and Quentin Tarantino, these generational filmmakers use the first few minutes to establish the identity of an entire movie. Because a truly great opening doesn't need to explain everything. It just needs to make us want to see what happens next.

What is YOUR Favorite Opening Scene to a movie?

title: Why The First Few Minutes Of A Movie Matter So Much
